name: Cyndee's Nail Salon
hours: Mon 9:30 AM–5 PM; Tue 9:30 AM–5 PM; Wed 9:30 AM–5:30 PM; Thu 9:30 AM–5:30 PM; Fri 9:30 AM–5:30 PM; Sat 9:30 AM–5 PM; Sun Closed

reviews.t: The ladies that work here are so very nice and it’s such a clean space. They however, do not do eyebrow waxing which I was a little disappointed in, but they definitely make up with it with their prices.
The girls were very friendly. Loved the massage chair. Best pedicure I’ve had in a long time!
Ask for Terry - best pedicure I’ve ever had.

I got my nails done there a few weeks ago. They did an amazing job and they where so nice. I got the holographic nails and I still have the holo on. They also do lots of other types that look AMAZING.

Got my nails done there a week and 1/2 ago. I had gotten acrylics done. which costs $50.00. and then a week and 1/2 two of the nails came off. they just popped off. went in and they said I had two choices: one I could either get 40% back and go somewhere else to get my nails done or I could get 10% off and they redo them. The owner was rude and not understanding. all he wanted was more money from me.

My sister and I went to get our nails done about 2 weeks ago, the next day, one of my nails started lifting. I let them know and they fixed it, but not even a week after that, we had NO acrylic nails left. I should’ve known to leave when they said they couldn’t do the ombré that I wanted… Not to mention the pedicure was mid AT BEST… An absolute waste of money!!!!! Do not waste your money here! Go somewhere where the people actually know how to do their job!!!

Got a gel manicure and regular pedicure on Saturday. My gel nails were peeling by Monday as the nail tech left clear coat all over my cuticles that made them crack and snag on stuff. A gel mani should last 2 weeks, not 2 days. My pedicure looks great but I would not recommend getting gel nails here.

The service was less than acceptable. The lady who did my pedicure was OK but I assume it takes effort to mess up feet. However, the guy who attempted to do my nails was horrible. Each nail looked like it belonged to different nail tech. He got defensive when I pointed out how the nails were crooked or different lengths and when I asked he just stop and undo what he did because it wasn't getting better. He cut off my real nails and thought I was going to pay for it. I only paid for the pedicure. I should have known better when he said he couldn't do ombre. Save your time and money. Not worth it.

The team here is so kind and talented! My friends and I came in about an hour before closing, they wanted pedicures and I needed a fill-in. We were worried they wouldn't have time for us all but they happily fit us in their schedule. My friend had a gift card that had been purchased under the previous owners and they were still kind enough to let her use it. All of our nails looked fabulous! I broke a nail a few days later at work and came in to have it repaired and when I asked how much I owed them they insisted it was free! I tipped them anyway because they're so nice and accommodating. I've had some bad experiences with customer service in some nail salons before where they've tried to push unwanted services on me in order to try to make more money, but at this salon they've never made me feel uncomfortable, they've never pushed any services I didn't ask for, and they've been so nice. I will never go to another nail salon in this area other than this one!

Had Appointments for me and my daughters for 2, 3 and 5 o’clock on Saturday. I get there and she tells me that she gave someone my appointment which was supposed to be at 3 . We waited over a hour and the girl that she gave my appointment to she started on her before my daughters so then of course I got really upset because I drove an hour and half and she didn’t even had the Decency to call and inform me. I told her that I was leaving because that was very Unprofessional and rude and she didn’t even apologize. Tatiana is not Reliable and very rude! And not good with Customer service. Ps I ask nicely could you not call ? She replied I don’t have a phone🤦🏼‍♀️ The nail salon has a phone.
